name: guardian
description: Adaptive Guardian: before each attempt, proposes one Guardian setup (stat tier, skills, strategy) tuned to the challenger, chosen only from engine-defined options.
owner: Tech Lead (student); approvals by the Executive Producer

interface.calls: once per attempt, at fight start; never during combat

allowed: allowed setup options and their descriptions

permissions.may: propose exactly one setup with every field from the allowed options
may_not: change damage, cooldowns, HP, or rewards

validation.fallback: default Guardian (scripted baseline), with the reason recorded in the trace

runtime.host: Unity Gaming Services Cloud Code C# module
runtime.secret: Anthropic API key in UGS secrets; never in the game client or this repository

evaluation: server/GuardianModule.Tests (deterministic); bounded live trials per Configuration Document 2.9
x-open: C1: confirm the required common-manifest fields against the syllabus and rename or add fields to match.
